text:
maria: Heads-up — starting next Tuesday (3/30) we'll flip the org-level GitHub Actions enforcement to disallow non-approved reusable workflows and enable the new CI linter as a required check. This is to stop fragile third-party actions from causing intermittent incidents.

ajay: Quick q: will this immediately block PRs or just warn at first?

maria: It will be staged: 24h warn window org-wide, then enforcement. We'll publish the warn->enforce timeline per repo owner.

lucy: Action items for teams: 1) run the linter locally (bin/ci-lint) 2) migrate to our approved reusable workflows (org/reusable/*) or add actions to allowlist request.

samir: If a repo uses a custom internal reusable workflow, do we need to register it?

maria: No — internal reusable workflows under our org are auto-approved. Only external actions or forks need allowlist entries.

dena: Security note: any workflow that uses 'runs-on: [self-hosted]' and downloads arbitrary scripts will require a short risk assessment. Please @me on PRs if you think your flow is high-risk.

ci-bot: Automated check: Scanned 240 repos, 38 use external actions not on our allowlist. Owners: @samir @team-data @team-helm (listed in DMs).

samir: Thanks — will triage. For repos that can't migrate in time, is there an escape hatch?

maria: Yes — temporary opt-out via repo label 'ci-temp-exempt' + an issue linking to a migration plan. Opt-outs expire after 14 days and must include a remediation ETA. Platform can extend in exceptional cases.

lucy: Docs updated: https://intranet.redwood/company/ci-enforcement (includes how to run the linter, allowlist request form, and sample issue template).

ajay: Any SRE impact? Will alerts start firing when enforcement blocks a release job?

maria: We will NOT auto-block production branch merges for the first week. Enforcement applies to PR checks only. Release pipelines that bypass PR checks (deploy workflows) get a compatibility grace period; we'll notify owners.

dena: I'll add a short runbook for oncall in case enforcement causes unexpected deploy failures.

maria: Timeline recap: Mon 3/29 — final warn scan + owner emails. Tue 3/30 09:00 UTC — warn mode (checks report but PRs still pass). Wed 3/31 09:00 UTC — enforce mode for PRs. Opt-outs available until 4/14. If you need more time, ping platform and include a remediation ETA.

samir: Noted. We'll start running bin/ci-lint across services today.

lucy: Tip: to test locally: docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/src ghcr.io/redwood/ci-linter:latest /src/.github/workflows && make ci-checks

maria: If you spot a repo that should be whitelisted org-wide (eg widely used community action vetted by security), open the allowlist request form. We'll aim for 48h turnaround for low-risk requests.

ci-bot: Reminder in 48h: owners with >0 failures will get a DM with remediation steps. :bell:

maria: Thanks everyone — please escalate any blocker into #release-war-room and tag me. :eyes:

ajay: :thumbsup:

lucy: :shipit:
